extension.summary: Repository of small, hand-picked Kodi addon fixes
Repozitár malých, ručne vybraných oprav Kodi addonov
extension.description: Hosts addons that have been forked and patched for a specific CoreELEC/Aeon Nox 5 setup. Currently: CU LRC Lyrics (Fixed), with an OK-button/OSD interaction fix.
Hostuje addony, ktoré boli forknuté a opravené pre konkrétny CoreELEC/Aeon Nox 5 setup. Zatiaľ: CU LRC Lyrics (Fixed), s opravou OK tlačidla/OSD.
extension.news: 1.0.0: initial release, includes CU LRC Lyrics (Fixed).

extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, with OK/OSD fix (fork)
CU LRC Lyrics, s opravou OK/OSD (fork)
extension.description: Fork of CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (original by Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) with two fixes applied: (1) the OK button on the remote no longer gets swallowed by the lyrics dialog's stolen input focus, and (2) pressing OK now shows the music OSD/menu, and the lyrics view automatically reopens (via the addon's own culrc.force mechanism) once the OSD is closed, instead of requiring a full navigation reset. See this repository's README for details.

Fork CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (originál od Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) s dvoma opravami: (1) tlačidlo OK na diaľkovom ovládači už nie je "zhltnuté" ukradnutým fokusom dialógu s textami, (2) stlačenie OK teraz zobrazí OSD menu a texty piesní sa automaticky znova otvoria (cez vlastný culrc.force mechanizmus addonu) po zatvorení OSD, bez nutnosti kompletného navigačného resetu. Podrobnosti v README tohto repozitára.
extension.news: 1.0.0: fork of upstream 6.7.1. Fixed OK button being swallowed by lyrics dialog focus; OK now shows OSD and lyrics auto-resume when OSD closes.

addon.name: Aeon Nox 5: CU LRC Lyrics topbar fix

extension.summary: Fixes a dark band over lyrics text in Aeon Nox 5
Opravuje tmavý pruh cez texty piesní v Aeon Nox 5
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons. It patches skin.aeon.nox.5's own CU LRC Lyrics override file (1080i/script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml) to hide the topbar.png control that overlays a dark band on top of the lyrics text during music playback. Requires skin.aeon.nox.5 to already be installed. Makes a one-time backup of the original file (.bak) before patching; running it again is a no-op if already patched. Restart Kodi afterwards for the change to take effect.

Spusti raz z Program add-ons. Opraví vlastný CU LRC Lyrics súbor skinu skin.aeon.nox.5 (1080i/script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml) tak, aby sa skryl topbar.png kontrolka, ktorá cez texty piesní prekrýva tmavý pruh. Vyžaduje už nainštalovaný skin.aeon.nox.5. Pred úpravou raz zálohuje pôvodný súbor (.bak); opätovné spustenie po oprave nič nerobí. Po spustení treba reštartovať Kodi.
extension.news: 1.0.3: added missing icon declaration. 1.0.2: fixed extension point (was the invalid bare "xbmc.python", now "xbmc.python.script" - that bare string is only valid in a requires/import, not as an addon's own type). 1.0.1: fixed repository install (bundled skin file was confusing Kodi's addon-type detection inside the zip). 1.0.0: initial release.

addon.name: CoreELEC: Network watchdog (connman restart on boot)

extension.summary: Restarts connman if no LAN IP shows up within 60s of boot
Reštartuje connman, ak sa do 60s od bootu neobjaví LAN IP
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons. Installs a systemd oneshot service (network-watchdog.service) and its script to /storage/.config/ on this CoreELEC box. At every boot it waits up to 60s for a 192.168.x.x LAN IP (ignoring WireGuard/OpenVPN/PPP tunnel interfaces); if none appears, it restarts connman and checks again. Fixes boots where the network never comes up on its own. Idempotent - running it again just confirms the files are already installed and the service enabled. Not a Kodi/skin fix - a system-level boot reliability fix, same delivery mechanism (a one-time Program add-on) as the other patches in this repo.

Spusti raz z Program add-ons. Nainštaluje systemd oneshot službu (network-watchdog.service) a jej skript do /storage/.config/ na tomto CoreELEC boxe. Pri každom boote počká až 60s na 192.168.x.x LAN IP (ignoruje WireGuard/OpenVPN/PPP tunelové rozhrania); ak sa neobjaví, reštartuje connman a skontroluje znova. Rieši booty, kde sieť sama nenabehne. Idempotentné - opätovné spustenie len potvrdí, že súbory sú už nainštalované a služba povolená. Nie je to oprava Kodi/skinu, ale systémová oprava spoľahlivosti bootu, doručená rovnakým spôsobom (jednorazový Program add-on) ako ostatné patche v tomto repozitári.
extension.news: 1.0.0: initial release - packages the network-watchdog systemd service confirmed working on x96max+.

extension.summary: Real fanart backgrounds for the currently playing music artist
extension.description: Lightweight replacement for Artist Slideshow. Looks up TheAudioDB / fanart.tv / Deezer for the currently playing artist and exposes the result via Window(Visualisation).Property(ArtistSlideshow.Image), compatible with the existing Aeon Nox 5 MusicVisualisation.xml patch. Runs as a proper Kodi background service (started once at Kodi startup) instead of a re-invoked script, avoiding the stuck/zombie "already running" issue.
extension.news: 1.2.0: fixed a real bug - xbmc.Player().getPlayingFile() returns a musicdb://songs/... virtual URL (not a real path) when a track is played from the Kodi music library view, which silently broke library-folder saving (it always fell back to the private cache instead). Now resolves the real on-disk path via Player.GetItem's "file" property first. 1.1.0: added Deezer as a third image source (no API key needed) - mainly helps Slovak/Czech and other regional artists that TheAudioDB/fanart.tv don't have at all. Added an on-screen "searching for fanart..." notification on first fetch for a new artist, so it's clear something is happening during the initial download delay. 1.0.0: initial release.
